title: Illustrative monthly unit-economics sensitivities
status: hypothetical editable scenarios, not forecasts or observed vendor economics
shopifyRevenueShareNote: 0% assumes developer is eligible and within the first $1,000,000 USD qualifying gross App Store revenue; otherwise add applicable share (commonly 15%, or 15% from dollar one for certain larger developers).

formula.supportBudgetAtTargetUSD: priceUSD * (1 - targetContributionMargin) - paymentFeeUSD - deliveryCostUSD - replacementCACUSD - priceUSD * shopifyRevenueShareRateAssumed
formula.interpretation: Negative support budget means the target margin is missed before support labor. Positive supportMinutesAtTarget is the maximum support time affordable at the target margin.

excludedCosts: fixed overhead and shared infrastructure allocation
founder salary, product development and tax
refunds, chargebacks, failed payments and annual discounts
onboarding or implementation except amounts explicitly included in deliveryCostUSD
collection usage above the category delivery allowance

scenarios.label: Low-priced self-serve Shopify app
scenarios.assumptionsNote: Hypothetical low-cost automated app; $0.25 direct monthly delivery reserve; $20 replacement CAC; 8% monthly churn.

scenarios.label: Bounded recurring monitor
scenarios.assumptionsNote: Hypothetical fixed-scope prompt/engine/cadence plan; $3 direct monthly delivery allowance; $100 replacement CAC; 5% monthly churn.

scenarios.label: Managed catalog repair
scenarios.assumptionsNote: Hypothetical recurring service with $15 monthly direct delivery reserve (equivalent to 30 minutes at $30/hour); $250 replacement CAC; 3% monthly churn. Additional labor is support and is constrained by the formula.
